metadata.description: MCP bridge for nnUNet4SoilXrayCT. Built-in VS Code tool aliases (read, search, edit, execute) handle most operations. This config is a placeholder for future custom MCP server tools.

autonomous_tools: fs_operations: read, edit, search (via built-in tool aliases)
shell_execution: execute (via built-in tool alias, @architect only)
human_gated_tools: label_remapping: changes to mask_to_nnUNet or dataset_info.json
threshold_modification: changes to Otsu, intensity constraints, mode detection
normalization_change: changes to zscore, rescale, norm200 parameters
metric_modification: changes to Dice formula, loss weights, smoothing

metadata.note: Enable the soil-ct-infra server once the MCP server stub is implemented. Until then, all tool capabilities are provided by VS Code's built-in tool aliases assigned to agents via YAML frontmatter.
